culture_metadata.name: Sinhalese Kingdoms of Sri Lanka (Saylan)
culture_metadata.summary_en: Succession of historic Theravada Buddhist monarchies across Sri Lanka (Polonnaruwa, Kotte, Gampola, Sitawaka) guarding the Sacred Tooth Relic and oceanic cinnamon trade.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Sri Lankan theravada-buddhalaisten kuningaskuntien ketju, joka suojeli Buddhan pyhää hammasta ja hallitsi Intian valtameren kanelikauppaa.

culture_metadata.name: Chané People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Chané is the collective name for the southernmost Arawakan-speaking peoples. They lived in the plains of the northern Gran Chaco and in the foothills of the Andes in Paraguay, Brazil, Bolivia, and Argentina. Their ancestral territory is situated in Gran Chaco lowlands (Argentina, Paraguay, Bolivia) (centered near 21.9°S, 63.2°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Chané-kansa on Etelä-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Gran Chacon alankoalueilla (Argentiinassa, Paraguayssa ja Boliviassa) (koordinaateissa noin 21.9°S, 63.2°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he harjoittivat alueensa luonnonoloihin sopeutunutta elämäntapaa ja vaalivat rikasta aineellista ja henkistä perinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Deg Xit'an People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Deg Xitʼan is a group of Athabaskan peoples in Alaska. Their native language is called Deg Xinag. Their ancestral country encompasses Subarctic Western Canada & Alaska (Dene & Athabaskan Lands) (centered near 62.5°N, 159.3°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Deg Xit'an Ngan' (Deg Xit'an)-kansa on Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Länsi-Kanadan ja Alaskan subarktisella havumetsäalueella (koordinaateissa noin 62.5°N, 159.3°W). culture_metadata.name: Nivaclé People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Nivaclé are an Indigenous people of the Gran Chaco. An estimated 13,700 Nivaclé people live in the President Hayes and Boquerón Departments in Paraguay, while approximately 200 Nivaclé people live in the Salta Province of Argentina. Their ancestral territory is situated in Gran Chaco lowlands (Argentina, Paraguay, Bolivia) (centered near 22.6°S, 61.1°W).

culture_metadata.name: Ikpeng People

They had a population of 459 in 2010, up from a low of 50 in 1969. Their ancestral territory is situated in Amazon Basin and Lowland Rainforests (centered near 11.2°S, 56.5°W).

Loukotka (1968) classified it as a language isolate, but there is insufficient data to justify this according to Campbell. Their ancestral territory is situated in Pampas and Río de la Plata Basin (centered near 30.1°S, 62.6°W).

culture_metadata.capital: Central Mexican altepetl or ceremonial hub
culture_metadata.summary_en: Chiso Co., Ltd. is the oldest textile producer in the world. Their ancestral country encompasses Mesoamerica (Central Mexican Highlands & Gulf Coast) (centered near 28.9°N, 103.3°W).

culture_metadata.name: Shipibo-Konibo People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Panoan-speaking nation of the Ucayali River floodplain in Peru, celebrated for their sacred ayahuasca shamanic icaros and mesmerizing kené geometric labyrinthine textile art.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Perun Ucayali-joen tulvatasangon pano-kielinen kansa, joka tunnetaan šamanistisista lauluistaan (icaros) ja lumoavista geometrisista kené-labyrinttikuvioistaan tekstiileissä ja saviastioissa.

culture_metadata.name: Akawaio/Akawayo People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Akawaio are an Indigenous people who live in Roraima (Brazil), Guyana, and Venezuela. They are closely related to the Ingarikó and Patamona. Their ancestral territory is situated in Llanos and Orinoco River Basin (centered near 6.2°N, 60.2°W).

culture_metadata.name: Guajajara People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Guajajara are an Indigenous people in the Brazilian state of Maranhão. They are one of the most numerous Indigenous groups in Brazil, with an estimated 13,100 individuals living on Indigenous land. Their ancestral territory is situated in Eastern Amazon & Tocantins Basin (Maranhão / Pará) (centered near 4.8°S, 45.8°W).

Their ancestral territory is situated in Amazon Basin and Lowland Rainforests (centered near 3.4°S, 71.5°W).

Their native territory includes the area surrounding the middle and upper Innoko River. Their ancestral country encompasses Subarctic Western Canada & Alaska (Dene & Athabaskan Lands) (centered near 63.3°N, 158.1°W).

culture_metadata.name: Ashanti Empire & Akan States
culture_metadata.summary_en: Powerful Akan empire founded by Osei Tutu I united by the sacred Golden Stool (Sika Dwa), commanding gold mining, kente weaving, and fighting five Anglo-Ashanti wars against British forces.

culture_metadata.name: Mojeño People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Mojeños, also known as Moxeños, Moxos, or Mojos, are an indigenous people of Bolivia. They live in south central Beni Department, on both banks of the Mamore River, and on the marshy plains to its west, known as the Llanos de Mojos. Their ancestral territory is situated in Central Andes and Lake Titicaca Altiplano (centered near 15.1°S, 65.3°W).

culture_metadata.name: Barasano/Panenoá People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Barasana (alternate names Barazana, Panenua, Pareroa, or Taiwano is an exonym applied to an Amazonian people, considered distinct from the Taiwano, though the dialect of the latter is almost identical to that of the Barasana, and outside observers can detect only minute differences between the two languages. They are a Tucanoan group located in the eastern part of the Amazon Basin in Vaupés Department in Colombia and Amazonas State in Brazil. Their ancestral territory is situated in Amazon Basin and Lowland Rainforests (centered near 0.3°N, 69.1°W).

culture_metadata.summary_en: Jetmir Haliti is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Kosovo national team. Their ancestral territory is situated in Amazon Basin and Lowland Rainforests (centered near 14.0°S, 57.7°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Halíti-kansa on Etelä-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Amazonin sademetsän ja alankojen jokilaaksoissa (koordinaateissa noin 14.0°S, 57.7°W). culture_metadata.name: Muisca Confederation
culture_metadata.summary_en: An advanced Chibchan-speaking confederation situated on the high Altiplano Cundiboyacense in the Eastern Range of the Colombian Andes. Ruled by the Zipa of Bacatá and Zaque of Hunza, the Muisca were famed for exquisite tumbaga gold votive figurines (tunjos), salt and emerald trade, and the sacred ritual at Lake Guatavita that birthed the legend of El Dorado.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Andien itäisellä ylängöllä (Altiplano Cundiboyacense) nykyisen Kolumbian alueella kukoistanut chibcha-kielinen valtioliitto, jota hallitsivat Bacatán Zipa ja Hunzan Zaque. Muiscat tunnettiin korkeatasoisesta kulta- ja kupariseoksesta (tumbaga) tehdyistä uhriesineistään, suola- ja smaragdikaivoksistaan sekä Guatavita-järven pyhästä rituaalista, josta sai alkunsa legenda El Doradosta.
culture_metadata.historical_period: Late Intermediate to Postclassic Northern Andes

culture_metadata.name: Cree Nation (Nêhiyaw)
culture_metadata.summary_en: Most populous First Nations group in Canada, spanning from James Bay (Moose Cree) through subarctic woodlands (Woodland Cree) onto the northern plains (Plains Cree / Nêhiyaw-Askiy).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Kanadan suurin alkuperäiskansaryhmä Jamesinlahdelta subarktisen metsävyöhykkeen halki Suurille tasangoille, jota johti muun muassa maineikas päällikkö Big Bear.

culture_metadata.name: Nasa People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Páez people, also known as the Nasa, are a Indigenous people who live in the southwestern highlands of Colombia, especially in the Cauca Department, but also the Caquetá Department lowlands and Tierradentro. Their ancestral territory is situated in Northern Andean Highlands and Valleys (Colombia) (centered near 2.4°N, 76.2°W).

Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he harjoittivat alueensa luonnonoloihin sopeutunutta elämäntapaa ja vaalivat rikasta aineellista ja henkistä perinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Goshute & Washoe Nations
culture_metadata.summary_en: Indigenous custodians of Lake Tahoe (Washoe / Wašišiw) and the Deep Creek Desert (Goshute), celebrated for Dat So La Lee's legendary degikup fine willow baskets.

culture_metadata.summary_fi: Itazipco-kansa on Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Suurten tasankojen (Great Plains) perinnealueilla (koordinaateissa noin 46.1°N, 102.5°W). culture_metadata.name: Atakapa-Ishak Nation
culture_metadata.summary_en: Indigenous hunting and fishing nation of the coastal marshes, bayous, and barrier islands of southwestern Louisiana and southeastern Texas, paddling cypress dugout pirogues.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Lounais-Louisianan ja Kaakkois-Texasin rannikkokosteikkojen ja rämeiden intiaanikansa, joka liikkui sypressipuusta koverretuilla kanooteillaan ja kalasti lahdilla.

culture_metadata.name: Asheninka People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Asháninka or Asháninca are an Indigenous people living in the rainforests in the regions of Junín, Pasco, Huánuco, and Ucayali in Peru, and in the State of Acre in Brazil. Their ancestral lands are in the forests of Junín, Pasco, Huánuco and part of Ucayali in Peru. culture_metadata.name: Hia-Ced O'odham People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Hia C-eḍ O'odham, also known as Areneños, are a Indigenous peoples of the Americas whose traditional homeland lies between the Ajo Range, the Gila River, the Colorado River, and the Gulf of California. They are unrecognized at both the state and federal level in the United States and Mexico, although the Tohono O'odham Nation has a committee for issues related to them and has land held in trust for them. Their ancestral country encompasses Aridoamerica and Sonoran Desert (Northern Mexico & Borderlands) (centered near 31.1°N, 112.7°W).

culture_metadata.name: Kawashkar People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Kawésqar, also known as the Kaweskar, Alacaluf, Alacalufe or Halakwulup, are an Indigenous people who live in Chilean Patagonia, specifically in the Brunswick Peninsula, and Wellington, Santa Inés, and Desolación islands northwest of the Strait of Magellan and south of the Gulf of Penas. Their traditional language is known as Kawésqar, a word that means “person” or “human being”; it is endangered as few native speakers survive. Their ancestral territory is situated in Patagonia and Tierra del Fuego (centered near 47.6°S, 74.1°W).

They live primarily on the Marañón River in northern Peru near the border with Ecuador and several of the Marañón's tributaries, the rivers Santiago, Nieva, Cenepa, Numpatakay and Chiriaco. Their ancestral territory is situated in Northern Peruvian Andes and Pacific Coast (centered near 4.8°S, 77.7°W).

culture_metadata.name: Penobscot Indian Nation

The Yuracaré reside not far from Santa Cruz de la Sierra and Cochabamba, among the forests and plains near the Andes. culture_metadata.name: Yamassee People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Yamasee were a multiethnic confederation of Native Americans (Indians) consisting of the survivors of several chiefdoms in Georgia destroyed by disruptions caused by European explorers and settlers in the 16th and 17th centuries. First coming to the attention of the Spanish in 1663, the Yamasee initially lived near the sea coast from northern Florida to South Carolina. However, they presently reside mainly in the municipalities of Aquidauana and Miranda within the Brazilian state Mato Grosso do Sul, as well as Mato Grosso and São Paulo. Their ancestral territory is situated in Pantanal, Mato Grosso and Southern Cerrado (centered near 20.4°S, 55.5°W).

culture_metadata.name: Macorix People

They claim descent from the historic Saponi people, a Tutelo-speaking tribe who occupied the Piedmont of North Carolina and Virginia. Although still robustly learned by children in Ecuadorian communities, Cofán is considered an 'endangered' language with estimates of around 1,500 native speakers. Pastot olivat taitavia maanviljelijöitä ja keramiikkataiteilijoita, jotka onnistuivat pysäyttämään inkkavaltakunnan pohjoisen laajentumisen ankarissa taisteluissa Huayna Capacin joukkoja vastaan.

culture_metadata.name: Kacha Edze (Urarina) People

According to both archaeological and historical sources, they have resided in the Chambira Basin of contemporary northeastern Peru for centuries. culture_metadata.name: Kañari People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Cañari are an indigenous ethnic group traditionally inhabiting the territory of the modern provinces of Azuay and Cañar in Ecuador. They are descended from the independent pre-Columbian tribal confederation of the same name. Their ancestral territory is situated in Northern Peruvian Andes and Pacific Coast (centered near 4.8°S, 79.4°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Kañari-kansa on Etelä-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Pohjois-Perun Andeilla ja Tyynenmeren rannikolla (koordinaateissa noin 4.8°S, 79.4°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he harjoittivat alueensa luonnonoloihin sopeutunutta elämäntapaa ja vaalivat rikasta aineellista ja henkistä perinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Pataxó People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Pataxó are an Indigenous people in Bahia, Brazil, with a population of about 11,800 individuals. They once spoke the Pataxó language, but now speak Portuguese and a reconstructed version of the Pataxó language called Patxohã. Their ancestral territory is situated in Atlantic Forest and Brazilian Highlands (centered near 17.7°S, 39.6°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Pataxó-kansa on Etelä-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Brasilian atlanttisen sademetsän (Mata Atlântica) ja ylänköjen alueella (koordinaateissa noin 17.7°S, 39.6°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he harjoittivat alueensa luonnonoloihin sopeutunutta elämäntapaa ja vaalivat rikasta aineellista ja henkistä perinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Mam People

culture_metadata.name: Kingdom of Hawaii

The Siona live in Sucumbios Province in Ecuador, mainly in the Cuyabeno Wildlife Reserve and in the Department of Putumayo along the Putumayo River. Their traditional territory lies between the Kiliwa on the south and the Kumeyaay and Cocopa on the north, and extending from San Vicente near the Pacific coast nearly to the Colorado River's delta in the east. Their ancestral country encompasses Aridoamerica and Sonoran Desert (Northern Mexico & Borderlands) (centered near 31.5°N, 115.9°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Paipai (Akwa'ala)-kansa on Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Aridoamerikassa ja Sonoran aavikolla Pohjois-Meksikon rajaseudulla (koordinaateissa noin 31.5°N, 115.9°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he vaalivat vuosisatojen perinteitä, sukulaisuusverkostoja ja rikasta suullista tarinaperinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Mojave, Quechan, Cocopah & Maricopa
culture_metadata.summary_en: River Yuman nations who farmed the annual floodplains of the Lower Colorado and Gila rivers, renowned for sacred dream journeys, running prowess, and geometric geoglyph earth art.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Colorado- ja Gila-jokien alajuoksun yuman-kansat, jotka viljelivät tulvatasankoja ja tunnettiin uniin perustuvasta hengellisestä perinteestään ja aavikkogeoglyfeistään.
culture_metadata.native_name: Pipa Aha Macav, Kwatsáan, Xawiƚƚ kwñchawaay & Piipaash

culture_metadata.name: Achumawi, Maidu & Wailaki
culture_metadata.summary_en: Northeastern California nations of Mount Shasta and the Pit and Feather rivers, adapting pit-fall game trapping and acorn-grinding technologies in mountain forests.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Koillis-Kalifornian Mount Shastan ja Pit-joen vuoristokansat, jotka kehittivät riistanpyyntikuoppia ja tammenterhon jauhantamenetelmiä vuoristometsissä.
culture_metadata.historical_period: Cascade Foothills & Feather River Indigenous Nations

culture_metadata.name: Huetar People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Huetares are an important Indigenous group of Costa Rica, who in the mid-16th century lived in the center of what is now the country. They are also mentioned with the name of güetares or pacacuas. Their ancestral country encompasses Mesoamerica (Maya Region & Central America) (centered near 10.0°N, 84.3°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Huetar-kansa on Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Mesoamerikassa mayojen ja Keski-Amerikan perinnealueilla (koordinaateissa noin 10.0°N, 84.3°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he vaalivat vuosisatojen perinteitä, sukulaisuusverkostoja ja rikasta suullista tarinaperinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Da’naxda’xw Awaetlatla Nation
culture_metadata.summary_en: Kwakwaka'wakw First Nation located at the head of Knight Inlet in coastal British Columbia, harvesting oolichan grease and building cedar longhouses.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Brittiläisen Kolumbian rannikolla Knight Inletin vuonon perukoilla asuva Kwakwaka'wakw-heimokansa, joka tunnetaan eulakonkalan rasvakeitosta ja setripuisista pitkätaloistaan.

culture_metadata.name: K'ómoks People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Kʼómoks are a Coast Salish Indigenous people whose traditional territory is centered in the north-central Salish Sea and southern Johnstone Strait. They are characterized by a common language. Their ancestral country encompasses Pacific Northwest Coast & Columbia Plateau (centered near 49.7°N, 125.4°W).

culture_metadata.name: Julimes People

culture_metadata.summary_fi: Julimes-kansa on Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Mesoamerikassa Keski-Meksikon ylängöillä ja Meksikonlahden rannikolla (koordinaateissa noin 28.4°N, 105.4°W). culture_metadata.name: Nahua Peoples
culture_metadata.summary_en: The largest indigenous linguistic family of Mesoamerica, whose speakers founded iconic postclassic city-states including Cholula, Texcoco, Chalco, and Tlaxcala. Originating in northwestern Mexico, Nahua migrations transformed the central valleys into centers of high literature, philosophy, codified jurisprudence, and monumental ceremonial architecture.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Mesoamerikan laajin alkuperäiskansojen kieliryhmä, johon kuuluivat muun muassa asteekit, tlaxcalalaiset ja texcocolaiset. Nahuat loivat Keski-Meksikoon rikkaan kaupunkivaltioiden verkoston, jolle oli ominaista korkeatasoinen runous, filosofia, lainsäädäntö ja arkkitehtuuri.

culture_metadata.name: Juhup-Yuju/Yuhupdëh People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Indigenous South American people and ethnic group whose ancestral territory is situated in Amazon Basin and Lowland Rainforests (centered near 0.6°S, 69.9°W). Documented at the eve of European contact in 1492, they developed intricate adaptations to their regional ecology, kinship networks, and cultural traditions.

culture_metadata.name: Lacandon People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Lacandon are one of the Maya peoples who live in the jungles of the Mexican state of Chiapas, near the southern border with Guatemala. Their homeland, the Lacandon Jungle, lies along the Mexican side of the Usumacinta River and its tributaries. Their ancestral country encompasses Mesoamerica (Maya Region & Central America) (centered near 16.6°N, 91.1°W).

Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he vaalivat vuosisatojen perinteitä, sukulaisuusverkostoja ja rikasta suullista tarinaperinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Jococobas People
culture_metadata.capital: Central Mexican altepetl or ceremonial hub
culture_metadata.summary_en: Indigenous North American nation and language group whose ancestral territory is situated in Mesoamerica (Central Mexican Highlands & Gulf Coast) (centered near 29.1°N, 106.4°W). Documented at the eve of European contact in 1492, they maintained deep ecological relationships with their ancestral lands, elaborate kinship systems, and rich oral traditions.

culture_metadata.name: Tilian People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Tilian Pearson, also known mononymously as Tilian, is an American singer-songwriter, musician and record producer born in Clearwater, Florida. culture_metadata.summary_en: Eastern Siouan nations of the Piedmont Carolinas along the Catawba and Pee Dee rivers, celebrated for continuous clay pottery making and serving as key American allies in the Revolution.

culture_metadata.name: Yukpa People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Yukpa are an Indigenous ethnic group that inhabits the northeastern part of the Cesar Department in northern Colombia by the Serranía del Perijá bordering Venezuela. Their territory covers the eastern areas of the municipalities of Robles La Paz, Codazzi and Becerril in Resguardos named Socorpa, Menkue, El Cozo Iroka and some other small areas in Venezuela. Their ancestral territory is situated in Northern Andean Highlands and Valleys (Colombia) (centered near 10.0°N, 73.1°W).

culture_metadata.name: Chinook Nation

culture_metadata.name: Guanches
culture_metadata.summary_en: The aboriginal Berber-descended inhabitants of the Canary Islands. Prior to Spanish conquest in the 15th century, they lived in isolated island chiefdoms, preserving unique cave architecture, whistling language (Silbo), and mummification traditions.

Like other Oto-Manguean languages, it is tonal and has complex inflectional morphology. Their ancestral country encompasses Mesoamerica (Central Mexican Highlands & Gulf Coast) (centered near 17.1°N, 98.9°W).

Their ancestral territory is situated in Gran Chaco lowlands (Argentina, Paraguay, Bolivia) (centered near 22.7°S, 58.7°W).

culture_metadata.name: Mixe (Ayuukjä'äy) People
culture_metadata.summary_en: An indigenous people inhabiting the rugged Sierra Mixe mountains of eastern Oaxaca. Descended from the ancient Mixe-Zoquean linguistic family linked to the Olmec civilization, the Mixe proudly call themselves 'the never conquered' (los jamás conquistados) for repelling both Zapotec, Aztec, and early Spanish military incursions.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Itä-Oaxacan jyrkillä Sierra Mixen vuorilla asuva alkuperäiskansa, jonka juuret juontuvat muinaisesta olmeekkeihin liitetystä mixe-zoque-kieliperheestä. Mixet kutsuvat itseään ylpeästi 'koskaan valloittamattomiksi', sillä he torjuivat niin zapoteekkien, asteekkien kuin espanjalaistenkin valloitusyritykset.

culture_metadata.name: Nomlaki People

culture_metadata.name: Waxhaw People

Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he harjoittivat alueensa luonnonoloihin sopeutunutta elämäntapaa ja vaalivat rikasta aineellista ja henkistä perinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Puruborá People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Puruborá are an indigenous people that inhabit the Brazilian state of Rondônia. They form a society of about 200 individuals. Their ancestral territory is situated in Amazon Basin and Lowland Rainforests (centered near 12.1°S, 63.4°W).

culture_metadata.name: Toara People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Takapūwāhia, also known as Porirua Pā, was originally built on one of the oldest settlements in the Porirua basin — Te Urukahika, a small hamlet located on the western shore of Porirua harbour in the lower North Island of New Zealand. Their ancestral territory is situated in South American Indigenous Territories (centered near 22.7°S, 65.6°W).

Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he harjoittivat alueensa luonnonoloihin sopeutunutta elämäntapaa ja vaalivat rikasta aineellista ja henkistä perinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Tama Dujo People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Kerstin Egert, known by the stage name Tama Sumo, is a German DJ and producer who has been called "one of the world's finest house and techno DJs whose success and acclaim stem only from her skills as a selector" by XLR8R. She is signed to the Ostgut Ton label and is a resident DJ at Berghain. Their ancestral territory is situated in Northern Andean Highlands and Valleys (Colombia) (centered near 2.9°N, 75.4°W).

culture_metadata.name: Westo People (Yuchi / Chichimeco)
culture_metadata.summary_en: Heavily armed Iroquoian or Yuchi-related warrior nation on the Savannah River that held a monopoly on Carolina gun-and-slave trading until defeated in the Westo War.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Aseistettu intiaanikansa Savannah-joen varrella Georgiassa ja Carolinassa, joka hallitsi alueellista asekauppaa ennen kuin englantilaiset tuhosivat sen Westo-sodassa.

culture_metadata.name: Quillacinga People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The following purported languages of South America are listed as unclassified in either Campbell (2024), Loukotka (1968), Ethnologue, or Glottolog. culture_metadata.summary_fi: Quillacinga-kansa on Etelä-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Pohjois-Andeilla ja vuoristolaaksoissa Ecuadorissa ja Kolumbiassa (koordinaateissa noin 1.3°N, 77.2°W). culture_metadata.name: Pawtucket People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Pennacook, also known by the names Penacook and Pennacock, were Algonquian Indigenous people who lived in what is now Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and southern Maine. They were not a united tribe but a network of politically and culturally allied communities. Their ancestral country encompasses Northeastern Woodlands and Great Lakes Basin (centered near 42.6°N, 71.3°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Pawtucket-kansa on Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Koillisten metsäalueiden ja Suurten järvien valuma-alueella (koordinaateissa noin 42.6°N, 71.3°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he vaalivat vuosisatojen perinteitä, sukulaisuusverkostoja ja rikasta suullista tarinaperinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Maijuna People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Moses ben Maimon, commonly known as Maimonides and also referred to by the Hebrew acronym Rambam, was a Sephardic Jewish rabbi who is widely acknowledged as one of the most prolific and influential Torah scholars of the Middle Ages. Their ancestral territory is situated in Amazon Basin and Lowland Rainforests (centered near 2.8°S, 72.9°W).

culture_metadata.name: Sugaree People

It was written for Jerry Garcia's first solo album Garcia, which was released in January 1972. Their ancestral country encompasses Southeastern Woodlands (Muskogean & Iroquoian Territory) (centered near 35.2°N, 81.1°W).

culture_metadata.name: Mixe (Ayuukjä'äy) People
culture_metadata.summary_en: An indigenous people inhabiting the rugged Sierra Mixe mountains of eastern Oaxaca. Descended from the ancient Mixe-Zoquean linguistic family linked to the Olmec civilization, the Mixe proudly call themselves 'the never conquered' (los jamás conquistados) for repelling both Zapotec, Aztec, and early Spanish military incursions.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Itä-Oaxacan jyrkillä Sierra Mixen vuorilla asuva alkuperäiskansa, jonka juuret juontuvat muinaisesta olmeekkeihin liitetystä mixe-zoque-kieliperheestä. Mixet kutsuvat itseään ylpeästi 'koskaan valloittamattomiksi', sillä he torjuivat niin zapoteekkien, asteekkien kuin espanjalaistenkin valloitusyritykset.

culture_metadata.name: Chaná People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Chaná were one of the Native nations of Argentina and Uruguay. Their native language is Chaná, which is only remembered by one person, Blas Wilfredo Omar Jaime. Their ancestral territory is situated in Pampas and Río de la Plata Basin (centered near 33.2°S, 58.4°W).

culture_metadata.name: Micqanaqa'n People

culture_metadata.name: Yaros People

The historic part of the city is a World Heritage Site, and is located at the confluence of the Volga and the Kotorosl rivers. Their ancestral territory is situated in Pampas and Río de la Plata Basin (centered near 33.4°S, 57.9°W).

Their traditional lands are near Mount Shasta, specifically the Pit River drainage on Burney, Hat, and Dixie Valley or Horse Creeks. Their ancestral country encompasses California Indigenous Country (Pacific Coast & Central Valley) (centered near 40.8°N, 121.1°W).

culture_metadata.name: Kaxixó People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Kaxixó are an Indigenous people of Brazil, located mainly in the Martinho Campos as well as the Pompéu municipalities of the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil. There are 301 Kaxixó as of 2014, who are dispersed over a wide area around the Kaxixó aldeia (village). Their ancestral territory is situated in Pantanal, Mato Grosso and Southern Cerrado (centered near 19.3°S, 45.1°W).

Their ancestral country encompasses Southeastern Woodlands (Muskogean & Iroquoian Territory) (centered near 36.1°N, 79.5°W).

culture_metadata.name: Mánekenk/Haush People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Haush or Manekʼenk people were an Indigenous people who lived on the Mitre Peninsula of the Isla Grande de Tierra del Fuego. They were related culturally and linguistically to the Selkʼnam people who also lived on the Isla Grande de Tierra del Fuego, and to the Tehuelche people of southern mainland Patagonia. Their ancestral territory is situated in Patagonia and Tierra del Fuego (centered near 54.8°S, 65.9°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Mánekenk/Haush-kansa on Etelä-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Patagoniassa ja Tulimaassa (koordinaateissa noin 54.8°S, 65.9°W). culture_metadata.name: Mayaimi Tribe
culture_metadata.summary_en: A Native American people who inhabited the Lake Okeechobee basin in southern Florida from antiquity until the 18th century. Expert fisherfolk and mound builders, they constructed extensive earthwork ceremonial mounds, canals, and raised platforms across the Everglades wetlands before disappearing following European contact.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Etelä-Floridassa Okeechobee-järven ympäristössä ja Evergladesin suoalueilla elänyt muinainen alkuperäiskansa. Mayaimit rakensivat laajoja maavalleja, kanavia ja kumpuja sekä elivät kalastuksella ja keräilyllä ennen häviämistään 1700-luvulla.

culture_metadata.summary_en: Indigenous coastal nations of Washington's Olympic Peninsula; the Chimakuan-speaking Quileute are famed for seal hunting, while the Quinault steward the prized blueback salmon.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Washingtonin osavaltion Olympic-niemimaan rannikkokansat; quileutet tunnetaan hylkeenpyyntitaidoistaan ja quinaultit vaalivat arvokasta Quinault-joen lohikantaa.

culture_metadata.name: Pomo Nations

Their ancestral territory is situated in Northern Andes and Inter-Andean Valleys (Ecuador/Colombia) (centered near 0.9°S, 78.8°W).

culture_metadata.summary_en: 'The Unconquered People' who coalesced in Florida from Muscogee migrants and Black Seminoles, waging three Seminole Wars against the U.S. Army in the Everglades under Osceola and Abiaka.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: 'Voittamaton kansa', joka muodostui Floridassa creek-muuttajista ja paenneista orjista ja kävi kolme sotaa Yhdysvaltain armeijaa vastaan Evergladesin suoalueilla Osceolan johdolla.

culture_metadata.name: Dokapuara (Tuyuca) People

Their ancestral territory is situated in Amazon Basin and Lowland Rainforests (centered near 0.4°N, 70.2°W).

Though the three varieties, Guambiano, Totoró, and the long-extinct Coconuco are traditionally called languages, Adelaar & Muysken (2004) believe that they are best treated as a single language. Their ancestral country encompasses Southeastern Woodlands (Muskogean & Iroquoian Territory) (centered near 37.0°N, 76.8°W).

culture_metadata.name: Tsa'chila People

Their native language is Tsafiki, a member of the Barbacoan linguistic family, and translates to mean "true word". Their ancestral territory is situated in Northern Andes and Inter-Andean Valleys (Ecuador/Colombia) (centered near 0.3°S, 79.3°W).

Their ancestral territory is situated in Amazon Basin and Lowland Rainforests (centered near 12.6°S, 60.6°W).

culture_metadata.name: Monqui People

Monqui territory included about 65 kilometres (40 mi) of coast along the Gulf of California and extended a few kilometers inland to where the Cochimi people lived. Their ancestral country encompasses Aridoamerica and Sonoran Desert (Northern Mexico & Borderlands) (centered near 25.8°N, 111.4°W).

culture_metadata.name: Nehalem People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Tillamook are a Native American tribe from coastal Oregon of the Salish linguistic group. The name "Tillamook" is a Chinook language term meaning "people of [the village] Nekelim ", sometimes it is given as a Coast Salish term, meaning "Land of Many Waters". Their ancestral country encompasses Pacific Northwest Coast & Columbia Plateau (centered near 45.8°N, 123.7°W).

Their ancestral country encompasses California Indigenous Country (Pacific Coast & Central Valley) (centered near 37.1°N, 122.1°W).

culture_metadata.name: Nahua Peoples
culture_metadata.summary_en: The largest indigenous linguistic family of Mesoamerica, whose speakers founded iconic postclassic city-states including Cholula, Texcoco, Chalco, and Tlaxcala. Originating in northwestern Mexico, Nahua migrations transformed the central valleys into centers of high literature, philosophy, codified jurisprudence, and monumental ceremonial architecture.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Mesoamerikan laajin alkuperäiskansojen kieliryhmä, johon kuuluivat muun muassa asteekit, tlaxcalalaiset ja texcocolaiset. Nahuat loivat Keski-Meksikoon rikkaan kaupunkivaltioiden verkoston, jolle oli ominaista korkeatasoinen runous, filosofia, lainsäädäntö ja arkkitehtuuri.

These three municipalities are known as the Ixil Triangle and are the place of origin of the Ixil culture and where the majority of the population lives. Their ancestral country encompasses Mesoamerica (Maya Region & Central America) (centered near 15.6°N, 91.1°W).

Its members, the malacostracans, display a great diversity of body forms and include crabs, lobsters, spiny lobsters, crayfish, shrimp, krill, prawns, isopods, amphipods, mantis shrimp, and many other less familiar animals. Their ancestral territory is situated in Northern Peruvian Andes and Pacific Coast (centered near 4.4°S, 79.2°W).

culture_metadata.name: Anacostan People

culture_metadata.summary_fi: Eastern Nehântick-kansa on Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Koillisten metsäalueiden ja Suurten järvien valuma-alueella (koordinaateissa noin 41.4°N, 71.6°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he vaalivat vuosisatojen perinteitä, sukulaisuusverkostoja ja rikasta suullista tarinaperinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Lummi People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Lummi are a Central Coast Salish people Indigenous to western Washington, namely parts of the San Juan Islands and the mainland near what is now Bellingham, Washington. Lummi people today are enrolled in the Lummi Nation, which is located west of Bellingham. Their ancestral country encompasses Pacific Northwest Coast & Columbia Plateau (centered near 48.8°N, 122.5°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Lhaq'temish (Lummi)-kansa on Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Tyynenmeren luoteisrannikolla ja Columbian ylängöllä (koordinaateissa noin 48.8°N, 122.5°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he vaalivat vuosisatojen perinteitä, sukulaisuusverkostoja ja rikasta suullista tarinaperinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Chibuleo People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Manuel Jiménez Moreno, better known as "Chicuelo", was a Spanish bullfighter. His contributions to tauromachy are held by some – writer and bullfighting critic Luis Nieto and writer Ignacio de Cossío Pérez de Mendoza among them – to be substantial, making bullfighting what it is today. Their ancestral territory is situated in Northern Andes and Inter-Andean Valleys (Ecuador/Colombia) (centered near 1.3°S, 78.7°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Chibuleo-kansa on Etelä-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Pohjois-Andeilla ja vuoristolaaksoissa Ecuadorissa ja Kolumbiassa (koordinaateissa noin 1.3°S, 78.7°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he harjoittivat alueensa luonnonoloihin sopeutunutta elämäntapaa ja vaalivat rikasta aineellista ja henkistä perinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Chimacum People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Chimacum is an unincorporated community in Jefferson County, Washington, United States, located in the center of the primary agricultural area of the eastern Olympic Peninsula. As of the 2020 census, Chimacum is not listed as a CDP despite being a prominent population center in the area. Their ancestral country encompasses Pacific Northwest Coast & Columbia Plateau (centered near 47.9°N, 122.8°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Chimacum-kansa on Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Tyynenmeren luoteisrannikolla ja Columbian ylängöllä (koordinaateissa noin 47.9°N, 122.8°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he vaalivat vuosisatojen perinteitä, sukulaisuusverkostoja ja rikasta suullista tarinaperinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Hatteras People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Croatan, also known as Hatteras, were a small Native American ethnic group living in the coastal areas of what is now North Carolina. They might have been a branch of the larger Roanoke people or allied with them. Their ancestral country encompasses Southeastern Woodlands (Muskogean & Iroquoian Territory) (centered near 35.4°N, 76.1°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Hatteras-kansa on Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Kaakkoisten metsämaiden ja jokilaaksojen alueella (koordinaateissa noin 35.4°N, 76.1°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he vaalivat vuosisatojen perinteitä, sukulaisuusverkostoja ja rikasta suullista tarinaperinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Ambaló People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Ambalona is a river in eastern Madagascar. It flows into the Indian Ocean south of Toamasina. Their ancestral territory is situated in Northern Andean Highlands and Valleys (Colombia) (centered near 2.6°N, 76.4°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Ambaló-kansa on Etelä-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Pohjois-Andien ylängöillä ja laaksoissa Kolumbiassa (koordinaateissa noin 2.6°N, 76.4°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he harjoittivat alueensa luonnonoloihin sopeutunutta elämäntapaa ja vaalivat rikasta aineellista ja henkistä perinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Krenak People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Aimoré (Aymore, Aimboré) are one of several South American peoples of eastern Brazil called Botocudo in Portuguese, in allusion to the wooden disks or tembetás worn in their lips and ears. Some called themselves Nac-nanuk or Nac-poruk, meaning "sons of the soil". Their ancestral territory is situated in Atlantic Forest and Brazilian Highlands (centered near 19.2°S, 41.3°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Krenak-kansa on Etelä-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Brasilian atlanttisen sademetsän (Mata Atlântica) ja ylänköjen alueella (koordinaateissa noin 19.2°S, 41.3°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he harjoittivat alueensa luonnonoloihin sopeutunutta elämäntapaa ja vaalivat rikasta aineellista ja henkistä perinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Huron-Wendat & Wyandot Nations
culture_metadata.summary_en: Powerful agricultural confederacies of Ontario and Lake Huron encompassing the Wendat and Neutral (Attiwonderonk) peoples, who controlled interior birchbark canoe fur trading networks.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Ontario- ja Huronjärven suuret maatalousliitot wendatit ja neutraalit (attiwonderonkit), jotka hallitsivat laajaa sisämaan turkiskauppaa kanootteineen ennen hajoamistaan.

culture_metadata.name: Cuicuilco People
culture_metadata.capital: Central Mexican altepetl or ceremonial hub
culture_metadata.summary_en: Cuicuilco is an archaeological site located on the southern shore of Lake Texcoco in the southeastern Valley of Mexico, in what is today the borough of Tlalpan in Mexico City. Their ancestral country encompasses Mesoamerica (Central Mexican Highlands & Gulf Coast) (centered near 19.3°N, 99.2°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Cuicuilco-kansa on Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Mesoamerikassa Keski-Meksikon ylängöillä ja Meksikonlahden rannikolla (koordinaateissa noin 19.3°N, 99.2°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he vaalivat vuosisatojen perinteitä, sukulaisuusverkostoja ja rikasta suullista tarinaperinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Kantaruré People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The following purported languages of South America are listed as unclassified in either Campbell (2024), Loukotka (1968), Ethnologue, or Glottolog. Nearly all are extinct. Their ancestral territory is situated in Caatinga and Brazilian Northeast coast (centered near 9.2°S, 38.4°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Kantaruré-kansa on Etelä-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Caatingan ja Koillis-Brasilian rannikon alueella (koordinaateissa noin 9.2°S, 38.4°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he harjoittivat alueensa luonnonoloihin sopeutunutta elämäntapaa ja vaalivat rikasta aineellista ja henkistä perinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Indigenous Nations in Oklahoma
culture_metadata.summary_en: Native American sovereign nations including the Otoe-Missouria, Peoria, and Sac and Fox peoples, historically relocated to Indian Territory (modern Oklahoma), preserving distinct tribal sovereignty and cultural heritages.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansoja kuten otoe-missouriat, peoriat sekä saukit ja ketut, jotka siirrettiin intiaanialueelle nykyiseen Oklahomaan ja jotka ylläpitävät omaa heimoperinnettään.

culture_metadata.name: Brothertown People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Brothertown is a town in Calumet County in the U.S. state of Wisconsin. Their ancestral country encompasses Northeastern Woodlands and Great Lakes Basin (centered near 44.0°N, 88.3°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Brothertown-kansa on Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Koillisten metsäalueiden ja Suurten järvien valuma-alueella (koordinaateissa noin 44.0°N, 88.3°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he vaalivat vuosisatojen perinteitä, sukulaisuusverkostoja ja rikasta suullista tarinaperinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Pascua Yaqui People
culture_metadata.summary_en: The Pascua Yaqui Tribe of Arizona is a federally recognized tribe of Yaqui Native Americans in the state of Arizona. Their ancestral country encompasses Aridoamerica and Sonoran Desert (Northern Mexico & Borderlands) (centered near 32.1°N, 111.1°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Pascua Yaqui-kansa on Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Aridoamerikassa ja Sonoran aavikolla Pohjois-Meksikon rajaseudulla (koordinaateissa noin 32.1°N, 111.1°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he vaalivat vuosisatojen perinteitä, sukulaisuusverkostoja ja rikasta suullista tarinaperinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Seminole Nation of Florida & Oklahoma
culture_metadata.summary_en: 'The Unconquered People' who coalesced in Florida from Muscogee migrants and Black Seminoles, waging three Seminole Wars against the U.S. Army in the Everglades under Osceola and Abiaka.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: 'Voittamaton kansa', joka muodostui Floridassa creek-muuttajista ja paenneista orjista ja kävi kolme sotaa Yhdysvaltain armeijaa vastaan Evergladesin suoalueilla Osceolan johdolla.

culture_metadata.name: Seminole Nation of Florida & Oklahoma
culture_metadata.summary_en: 'The Unconquered People' who coalesced in Florida from Muscogee migrants and Black Seminoles, waging three Seminole Wars against the U.S. Army in the Everglades under Osceola and Abiaka.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: 'Voittamaton kansa', joka muodostui Floridassa creek-muuttajista ja paenneista orjista ja kävi kolme sotaa Yhdysvaltain armeijaa vastaan Evergladesin suoalueilla Osceolan johdolla.

culture_metadata.name: Halalt People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Halalt First Nation' is a First Nations tribe located on a reservation on the Chemainus River in southeastern Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada. The Halalt were originally from the village xeláltxw once located in the Cowichan Valley, and likely moved to Willy Island, the largest of the Shoal Islands, in the early 19th century. Their ancestral country encompasses Pacific Northwest Coast & Columbia Plateau (centered near 48.8°N, 123.7°W).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Halalt-kansa on Pohjois-Amerikan alkuperäiskansa, jonka perinteiset maat sijaitsevat alueella Tyynenmeren luoteisrannikolla ja Columbian ylängöllä (koordinaateissa noin 48.8°N, 123.7°W). Vuoden 1492 historiallisessa horisontissa he vaalivat vuosisatojen perinteitä, sukulaisuusverkostoja ja rikasta suullista tarinaperinnettä.

culture_metadata.name: Sámi Peoples
culture_metadata.summary_en: The indigenous Finno-Ugric people inhabiting Sápmi across northern Norway, Sweden, Finland, and the Kola Peninsula of Russia. Renowned for their ancient ecological adaptation to subarctic environments, rich oral tradition (yoik), and semi-nomadic seasonal subsistence.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Euroopan unionin ainoa alkuperäiskansa, jonka asuinalue Sápmi ulottuu Pohjois-Norjaan, -Ruotsiin, -Suomeen ja Kuolan niemimaalle. Saamelaiskulttuuri perustuu vahvaan luontoyhteyteen, omaan kieli- ja joikuperinteeseen sekä poronhoitoon.

culture_metadata.name: Wari Empire
culture_metadata.summary_en: A sophisticated expansionist state centered in the Ayacucho Basin of highland Peru that, alongside Tiwanaku, defined the Middle Horizon. The Wari pioneered centralized provincial administrative enclaves, rectilinear walled compounds, terraced agricultural hillsides, and a paved highway network that anticipated the imperial infrastructure of the later Inca.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Andien ylängöllä Ayacuchon laaksossa syntynyt keskitetty ja sotilaallinen valtakunta, joka hallitsi suuria osia nykyisestä Perusta Tiwanakun rinnalla. Warit rakensivat laajoja suorakulmaisia hallintokaupunkeja (kuten Pikillacta), maatalouden porrasteryhmiä ja kattavan tieverkoston, jotka loivat pohjan myöhemmälle inkkainfrastruktuurille.

culture_metadata.name: Kichwa Peoples
culture_metadata.summary_en: Northern Quechua-speaking indigenous nations spanning the Andean cordillera and upper Amazon basin of Ecuador, Peru, and Colombia. Spreading originally during Inca imperial resettlement policies and subsequent colonial trade, the Kichwa developed rich weaving industries (Otavalo) and resilient Amazonian agroforestry communities along the Napo, Pastaza, and Tigre rivers.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Ecuadorin ja Perun Andien ylängöillä sekä Amazonian yläjuoksulla asuvat ketsuan kielen pohjoismurteita puhuvat alkuperäiskansat. Kichwat kehittivät maailmankuulun Otavalon tekstiilikudontaperinteen sekä kestävät sademetsän viljelyjärjestelmät Napo-, Pastaza- ja Tigre-jokien varsilla.
culture_metadata.historical_period: Inca to Modern Northern Andean & Amazonian Expansion

culture_metadata.name: Thule Tradition (Ancestral Inuit)
culture_metadata.summary_en: Ancestors of all modern Canadian, Alaskan, and Greenlandic Inuit, the Thule expanded rapidly eastward from the Bering Strait around 1000 CE armed with dog sleds, large umiaks, and bowhead whaling expertise.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Kaikkien nykyisten Kanadan, Alaskan ja Grönlannin inuiittien esivanhemmat; Thule-kansa levittäytyi Beringinsalmelta itään koiravaljakoiden ja suuren valaanpyynnin siivittämänä.

culture_metadata.name: Iñupiaq People
culture_metadata.summary_en: Inuit people of northwestern Alaska inhabiting the Arctic Slope and Seward Peninsula, renowned for cooperative bowhead whale hunting (agviq) and the Nalukataq blanket toss celebration.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Luoteis-Alaskan ja arktisen rannikon inuiittikansa, joka tunnetaan grönlanninvalaan yhteisöllisestä pyynnistä (agviq) ja kevään Nalukataq-juhlan nahkapompuista.

culture_metadata.name: Yup'ik & Cup'ik Peoples
culture_metadata.summary_en: Eskimo-Aleut peoples of the expansive Yukon-Kuskokwim Delta and coastal southwest Alaska, maintaining vibrant dance festivals (kelek), qasgiq communal houses, and rich subsistence salmon fisheries.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Lounais-Alaskan Yukon- ja Kuskokwim-jokien suiston alkuperäiskansat, jotka tunnetaan perinteisistä tansseistaan, qasgiq-miestentaloistaan ja lohenkalastuksestaan.

culture_metadata.name: Dehcho & South Slavey Dene
culture_metadata.summary_en: Dene First Nations along the great Dehcho (Mackenzie River) and Hay River in the Northwest Territories and northern Alberta, sustaining moose hunting, trapping, and self-governance.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Suuren Dehcho-joen (Mackenzie) ja Hay-joen varsien denekansat Luoteisterritorioissa ja Pohjois-Albertassa, jotka harjoittavat hirvenmetsästystä ja itsenäistä heimohallintoa.

culture_metadata.name: Sahtu Dene & Métis Nation
culture_metadata.summary_en: Dene inhabitants of the pristine Sahtú (Great Bear Lake) region and Mackenzie Mountains, including the Acho Dene Koe of Fort Liard, governing under the Sahtu Comprehensive Land Claim.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Suuren Karhujärven (Sahtú) ja Mackenzievuorten denekansa, johon kuuluvat myös Fort Liardin Acho Dene Koe; hallinnoi aluettaan Sahtun maasopimuksen nojalla.

culture_metadata.name: Gwich'in Nation
culture_metadata.summary_en: Northernmost Athabaskan nation across Alaska and the Yukon whose spiritual and physical life is bound to the sacred Porcupine caribou herd and the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge calving grounds.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Pohjoisin athabascakansa Alaskan ja Yukonin alueella, jonka henkinen ja aineellinen elämä kietoutuu pyhään Porcupine-karibulaumaan ja arktisen luonnonpuiston suojeluun.

culture_metadata.name: Dehcho & South Slavey Dene
culture_metadata.summary_en: Dene First Nations along the great Dehcho (Mackenzie River) and Hay River in the Northwest Territories and northern Alberta, sustaining moose hunting, trapping, and self-governance.

culture_metadata.name: Kaska Dena & Tahltan Nations
culture_metadata.summary_en: Athabaskan nations spanning northeastern British Columbia and southern Yukon across the Cassiar Mountains and Stikine volcanic plateau, controlling historic obsidian trading routes.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Brittiläisen Kolumbian koillisosien ja eteläisen Yukonin athabascakansat, jotka hallitsivat Stikine-joen ja Cassiar-vuoriston muinaisia obsidiaanikauppareittejä.

culture_metadata.name: Innu Nation (Montagnais-Naskapi)
culture_metadata.summary_en: Indigenous Algonquian hunters of Nitassinan spanning Labrador and eastern Quebec, who tracked the massive George River caribou herd across subarctic lichen woodlands for millennia.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Nitassinanin (Labradorin ja itäisen Quebecin) algonkin-metsästäjäkansa, joka seurasi vuosituhansia George-joen valtavaa karibulaumaa subarktisissa jäkälämetsissä.

culture_metadata.name: Khanate of Sibir
culture_metadata.summary_en: A northern Turco-Mongol khanate in western Siberia that gave Siberia its name. Governed by Khan Kuchum until conquered by Russian Cossack forces led by Yermak Timofeyevich.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Turkkilais-mongolilainen kaanikunta Länsi-Siperiassa, josta koko Siperian maantieteellinen nimi juontuu. Kasakkapäällikkö Jermak kukisti kaani Kutšumin ja avasi Siperian Venäjälle.

culture_metadata.name: White Horde
culture_metadata.summary_en: A major constituent division of the Golden Horde ruling the steppes of modern Kazakhstan and western Siberia, which played a critical role in the unification of the Golden Horde under Tokhtamysh.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Kultaisen ordan merkittävä valtakeskus nykyisen Kazakstanin arolla, joka yhdisti arovallat Toktamyš-kaanin johdolla 1300-luvun lopulla.

culture_metadata.name: Crimean Khanate
culture_metadata.summary_en: A Crimean Tatar state ruled by the Giray dynasty. An autonomous protectorate of the Ottoman Empire, it dominated the Black Sea northern coast until annexed by Catherine the Great.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Giray-dynastian hallitsema Krimin tataarien valtio, joka toimi pitkään Osmanien valtakunnan liittolaisena ja Mustanmeren pohjoispuolisten arojen mahtina ennen Katariina Suuren tekemää liitosta.

culture_metadata.name: Tibet
culture_metadata.summary_en: The historic civilization and theocratic polity of the Tibetan Plateau, governed by the Dalai Lamas from the Potala Palace under the Ganden Phodrang administration until the 1950s.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Tiibetin ylängön historiallinen sivilisaatio ja teokraattinen hallitus, jota dalai-lamat johtivat Potalan palatsista Lhasasta käsin aina 1950-luvun tapahtumiin asti.
culture_metadata.historical_period: Era of Fragmentation to Modern Era

culture_metadata.name: State of the Teutonic Order & Old Prussians
culture_metadata.summary_en: Crusader monastic state along the southeastern Baltic coast established by German knightly brethren, conquering the Baltic Old Prussians and constructing the colossal brick castle of Malbork (Marienburg).
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Saksalaisen ritarikunnan ristiretkivaltio Itämeren kaakkoisrannikolla, joka alisti muinaispreussilaiset ja rakennutti Euroopan suurimman tiililinnan Malborkiin.

culture_metadata.name: Adal & Ifat Sultanates
culture_metadata.summary_en: Muslim Somali-Afar-Harari state in the Horn of Africa centered at Zeila and Harar, launching a major 16th-century conquest against the Ethiopian Empire led by Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Afrikan sarven islamilainen sulttaanikunta Zeilan ja Hararin kaupungeissa, joka kävi 1500-luvulla laajan valloitussodan Etiopian keisarikuntaa vastaan imaami Ahmad Gragnin johdolla.

culture_metadata.name: Kingdom of Poland & Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth
culture_metadata.summary_en: Pioneering early modern noble republic (Golden Liberty) with a multi-confessional elected monarch, fielding the famed Winged Hussars under John III Sobieski and adopting Europe's first written constitution in 1791.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Puolan ja Liettuan suuri monikansallinen liittovaltio ja aatelistasavalta, jonka siivekkäät husaarit ratkaisivat Wienin taistelun 1683 ja joka hyväksyi Euroopan ensimmäisen perustuslain 1791.

culture_metadata.name: Christian Nubian Kingdoms
culture_metadata.summary_en: Three medieval Christian kingdoms (Nobatia, Makuria, and Alodia/Alwa) along the Middle Nile that preserved Coptic and Old Nubian liturgies, signing the 600-year Baqt treaty with Arab Egypt.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Niilin keskijuoksun kolme keskiaikaista kristittyä kuningaskuntaa (Nobatia, Makuria ja Alwa), jotka säilyttivät koptilaisen kirkkotaiteen ja solmivat Baqt-rauhansopimuksen arabien kanssa.

culture_metadata.name: Funj Sultanate of Sennar
culture_metadata.summary_en: Islamic sultanate along the Blue Nile that succeeded Christian Alodia, controlling Sudan's trade caravans and promoting Islamic learning and Sufism until conquest by Muhammad Ali's Egypt.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Sinisen Niilin varrella toiminut islamilainen sulttaanikunta Sudanissa, joka valvoi kauppakaravaaneja ja tuki suufilaista oppineisuutta aina Egyptin valloitukseen (1821) saakka.

culture_metadata.name: Merina Kingdom & Republic of Madagascar
culture_metadata.summary_en: Highland kingdom of the Austronesian-speaking Merina people unified by King Andrianampoinimerina and Queen Ranavalona I, ruling the world's fourth largest island from the Rova of Antananarivo.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Madagaskarin ylänköjen austronesialaisen merinakansan kuningaskunta, joka yhdisti koko saaren ja hallitsi sitä Antananarivon kuninkaallisesta palatsista (Rova).

culture_metadata.name: Ming Dynasty
culture_metadata.summary_en: Restoring native Han Chinese governance after Mongol rule, the Ming rebuilt the Great Wall in stone, constructed Beijing's Forbidden City, dispatched Zheng He's maritime treasure fleets, and dominated global silver trade.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Palautti han-kiinalaisen vallan mongolien jälkeen. Ming-dynastia rakensi Kielletyn kaupungin, vahvisti Kiinan muurin kivilinnoituksin ja lähetti Zheng Hen suuret aarrelaivastot Intian valtamerelle.

culture_metadata.name: Taiwan
culture_metadata.summary_en: An East Asian island nation home to indigenous Austronesian peoples, experiencing Dutch colonial rule, the Kingdom of Tungning, Qing rule, Japanese administration, and becoming a flourishing democratic semiconductor leader.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Itäaasialainen saarivaltio, joka on austroneesialaisten kansojen alkukoti. Kokenut Hollannin siirtomaavallan, Tungningin kuningaskunnan, Qing-hallinnon ja noussut moderniksi teknologiakeskukseksi.

culture_metadata.name: Japan
culture_metadata.summary_en: A democratic island nation in East Asia renowned for its post-war economic miracle, cutting-edge technology, automotive excellence, anime and gaming culture, and preservation of ancient shrines and temples.
culture_metadata.summary_fi: Itäaasialainen demokraattinen saarivaltio, joka tunnetaan sotienjälkeisestä talousihmeestään, huipputeknologiastaan, autoteollisuudestaan, populaarikulttuuristaan ja vanhoista temppeleistään.
